target.statement: H2: R_{D,m}(e) < 0 for every e in (0, E], E = 2
target.domain_reduction_source: p5x_global_nonlinear_dynamics/FROZEN_THEOREM.md section 8 P5X-T7(1); FEASIBILITY_AUDIT.md section 8 (e > 2 licensed by K1 sup|R| < 2)
premises: R(0) = 0 exactly and R continuous (P5-T3, H1)
R differentiable with |R''| <= M_R2 on each cell (frozen curvature_bound semantics)
input records are K1 PRODUCTION records bound to their governed producer identity

inputs.SR: sealed PS1 production cell records -> evidence t4_NNNN.json; integrity: file sha256 == sealed evidence sha256 and t4_record_sha256 == sha256(t4_cell.canonical(record minus t4_record_sha256))
inputs.CUSUM: Aux4 full-cover production records under producer identity of the rerun; integrity attested by the Aux4 verifier (hash_v2/audit4) before assembly
inputs.cells: every frozen cover cell whose closed interval intersects (0, 2]; symbolic (c_SR-dependent) cells refused

arithmetic: exact rational (Fraction) over the recorded outward endpoints; no floating point; strict inequalities

per_cell_enclosures.R_cell: [R.lo - rho*mag(D) - rho^2*M/2 , R.hi + rho*mag(D) + rho^2*M/2]  (frozen ledger.taylor_enclosure)
per_cell_enclosures.M: the recorded M_R2 (magnitude); R2_interval is never used signed

decision_procedure: 1 cover check: cells sorted by left endpoint; first left == 0 exactly; each left == previous right exactly; last right >= 2; else COVER_GAP
2 chain: the maximal prefix of cells from e = 0 with Rprime_cell.hi < 0 certifies R < 0 on (0, right of prefix]
3 direct: every remaining cell must have R_cell.hi < 0
4 counterexample: any cell with R.lo > 0 (certified R(e0) > 0) is MATHEMATICAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE
5 any other cell is CERTIFICATE_TOO_LOOSE; no refinement, splitting, retry, delta or threshold is tunable
